new_value: Already fixed: Routing link layer integration is fully implemented in lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/router.c. The unified hybrid router provides address classification (lichen_router_classify), gradient table lookups, RPL parent forwarding (via lichen_rpl_accessor), LOADng discovery (via lichen_loadng_accessor), GPSR fallback (lichen_router_gpsr_forward), and pending packet queuing. L2 integration exists via lichen_l2_set_gradient_table and announce.c L2 payload handling.
